idea: I am a freelance illustrator and invoicing eats my evenings. I want something that turns my logged hours into invoices and tracks who has paid. It must run on the cheap shared hosting I already pay for, and I refuse to pay monthly for yet another SaaS.

problem: Invoices go out late and I lose track of unpaid ones; twice last year I simply forgot to bill a client.
user: Only me. Clients get a PDF by email; they never touch the system.
workflow: I log hours per project as I work; at month end I pick a client, the tool drafts the invoice from unbilled hours, I send it and mark payments when they arrive.
success: Every month closes with all hours billed within three days and I can see outstanding balances at a glance.
constraints: Shared PHP-era hosting: no long-running processes, no additional paid services, no monthly subscription. My accountant needs a CSV export at year end.
Invoices must carry my country's VAT number and sequential invoice numbers with no gaps — a legal requirement.
non-goals: No time-tracking timers, no client portal, no online payment collection.
